scenarios.name: chosen-goblin-reduced-by-two
scenarios.why: Incubator chooses Goblin as it enters. The matching Goblin Piledriver's generic component is reduced by two, leaving only {R} to pay.

scenarios.name: nonmatching-creature-retains-generic-cost
scenarios.why: Grizzly Bears is not the chosen Goblin type, so {G} alone cannot pay its {1}{G} cost.

scenarios.name: colored-component-is-not-reduced
scenarios.why: The reduction applies only to generic mana. Even though Savannah Lions matches Cat, its white mana requirement remains and colorless mana cannot pay it.
